judgment.notes: M007 is instantiated over ℝ on Space×ℝ, first into Value and then into the recursively formed continuous-linear-map spaces. Each point of the open O has the required neighborhood equality, first by F001 and subsequently by the induction hypothesis on all of O. Constant derivatives are zero. M001 is instantiated with Space, ℝ, dx and each h: Borel measurability of opens, finite measure on compacts, continuity and compact topological support all hold before its use. The supplied signatures impose no additional material premise in these instantiations.

H006 applies to the positive finite slab endpoints. Compactness makes C closed, so local constancy on O supplies the derivative-zero base and the explicit all-points induction step. The section chain rule identifies the listed first and second derivative fields, and the formulas make e,d vanish. Smoothness on U gives continuity of every positive-time spatial section. Finite products, dot products and real linear combinations remain continuous and zero outside the same C; closedness of C gives compact tsupport and M001 gives integrability. S004 closes all quantifiers and uses t0∈I. No derivative at a slab endpoint or at time zero, and no exchange of a limit and an integral, is required. The reasoning also covers n=0 or m=0.

scope: Coverage is reviewer-reported; reading alone is not mathematical assessment.
